text_block_list.text: One day, with summer training camp just around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, fan letters?
We can't exactly bring those along to the training camp, can we—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I want to write as many replies as I can while I'm still at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My elder sister was distinctly different on that day.
And she still is now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Because your expectations, too,
are something I need.
Setting clouds adrift against the vast, serene blue sky――
